by
  let hf_bounded := hf_infinity
  let hf_zero_iff := UpperHalfPlane.isZeroAtImInfty_iff hf_bounded
  let ⟨A, hA⟩ := UpperHalfPlane.isBoundedAtImInfty_iff hf_bounded
  let h_cont := hf_cont
  let h_compact := Continuous.continuousOn_compact (UpperHalfPlane.compact_half_plane A)
  let h_bound_compact := h_cont.continuousOn_boundedOn h_compact
  let ⟨M, hM⟩ := hA
  let h_bound_all := h_bound_compact hM
  let C := max M (h_bound_all.1)
  exact ⟨C, λ τ, max_le C M (h_bound_all.2 τ)⟩
